says: In our tooling and next/ config, the L3 law of decision 0573 (preferSchemaTaggedError stays at error in every tracked tsconfig) fails on main: 12 project tsconfigs say the level is undefined. Two pull requests crossed. Pull request 1498 added the law, which reads each tsconfig's own checker block and expects the level there. Pull request 1462 gave 12 projects their own checker block for the import form (0577), without that level. Neither branch had the other's change. Main's scheduled run 43826039764 on b490a3203 skipped its tests by the hourly cap, so nothing caught it. The checker itself still ran the check at error in those projects, since it merges a project's block into the base's (0577); the law does not model that merge. Fixed here by naming the level in each of the 12 blocks.
proof: At b490a3203, vitest on oxlint-plugins/effect-checks-held.test.ts fails with 12 lines of 'preferSchemaTaggedError is undefined'. A Data.TaggedError class planted in next/programs/counter/src, run with effect-tsgo diagnostics on that project, gives 'error effect(preferSchemaTaggedError)'. After the fix, the law and oxlint-plugins/effect-checks.test.ts pass.
cost: Main's next full run fails on this law, and any pull request whose CI runs this law is red until the fix lands.
